name: catlas_accessible_genes
description: Cell-type accessible gene sets from CATlas human scATAC-seq via promoter overlap with background-controlled specifically-accessible regions

inputs.name: bed_dir
inputs.description: Directory containing background-prevalence-controlled cell-type-specifically-accessible region files (*_Up.bed.gz). Each file represents one cell type; filenames use the convention {cell_type}_Up.bed.gz with '___' as a separator for multi-word cell type names.

inputs.name: refgene_gz
inputs.description: UCSC refGene.txt.gz for GRCh38/hg38. If not provided the file is automatically downloaded from https://hgdownload.soe.ucsc.edu/goldenPath/hg38/database/refGene.txt.gz and cached under out_dir/references/.

parameters.name: promoter_window
parameters.help: Half-width of the promoter window around the TSS in base pairs. Promoter = TSS +/- promoter_window. Default 1000.

parameters.name: bin_size
parameters.help: Genome bin size in base pairs used for region-to-promoter overlap. Must match the bin size used to generate the input BED files. Default 1000.

outputs.name: <set_name>/genesets.gmt
outputs.description: GMT file with one gene set per cell type

outputs.name: <set_name>/geneset.tsv
outputs.description: Gene list for this cell type's accessible genes
